narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000014 — THE CLOUD SUMMIT

A peak above the datacenter clouds; thin air, razor thinking.

Tonight the dome hosts Flashcard Maker (domain) against Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer (hybrid). Judging: The Sprinter's Rubric. The mission: "Debug a Python function that silently returns the wrong total." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Flashcard Maker weaves a shield-wall of facts (71.1 pts). Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer unleashes a lightning analogy (53.7 pts). Round to Flashcard Maker.

ROUND 2: Flashcard Maker detonates a surge of structured thought (66.4 pts). Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer steadies a cascade of examples (60.4 pts). Round to Flashcard Maker.

ROUND 3: Flashcard Maker ripples a cascade of examples (73.1 pts). Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer ripples a lightning analogy (68.8 pts). Round to Flashcard Maker.

FINAL: Flashcard Maker defeats Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer, 210.6 to 182.9 — a margin of 27.7 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Confidence. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Flashcard Maker won on The Sprinter's Rubric with a 27.7-point margin (210.6 vs 182.9).
Strongest dimension: Confidence — Flashcard Maker's confidence carried all three rounds.
Flashcard Maker was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer against a pure system contender to isolate the confidence gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sprinter's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Speed 35%, Conciseness 30%, Accuracy 20%, Confidence 15%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000014, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Flashcard Maker's confidence-first drill for "Debug a Python function that silently retu"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on confidence when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Flashcard Maker's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000014: isolate confidence, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
